answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 59 epochs. Receipts are issued in wharf, burned on slash in pigment, and listed in anchor. That removes the yield an attacker would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 75 aliases cost 127 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
